generic: The System is watching. Act accordingly.
A new day. The Gates are open.
Your directive is ready. Begin with the hardest one.
Effort is the only currency the System accepts.
Intentions are not recorded. Actions are.
The ledger is waiting for today's first line.
No one else can clear your Gates.
Small quests, cleared daily, outrank grand plans.
Start before you feel ready. The System does not wait.
Every level began as a single quest.
Your stats reflect your days. Choose today's carefully.
The System has no opinion of you. Only a record.
One quest is enough to begin.

{streak} consecutive days. Few hunters reach this far.

STR is fading from your record. Move today.
